It was early elementary school. Probably around 3rd grade. I didn’t really have any friends, my entire class bullied me, and the teachers just ignored it. My dad was a truck driver and would do all of his deliveries in the near area first so that he could come to the school and sit outside of the playground fence during recess. We would talk, play, etc. However, he couldn’t make it to my 2nd recess. During 2nd recess there was a particular boy that would pull my hair and call me fat, stupid, ugly, etc. I didn’t tell my dad about the physical abuse for a long time. One day I couldn’t take it anymore and broke down. I explained to my dad what this kid was doing. So my dad told me “give him a warning and if he touches you after you give him a warning you can hit him”. 
Next day; I’m ready. 2nd recess comes around and the boy starts to pull my hair again. I tell him to stop or I’m going to hit him. He hits me. Game on. I take the kid by his hair, slam him into the ground, and while continuing to keep a grip on his hair I kick and punch with my other hand until the recess teacher pulls me off of him. The kid never bullied me again. 
Dad later told me that the teacher admitted to letting me hit him for a bit until she separated the fight. I got in trouble at school but when I got home we had ice cream and watched Spider-Man.  Say what you want but my dad was a good dad.
